scope: Interrupted baseline only. Actual software trigger, Stop and commanded Withdraw are preserved separately from image quality. No complete-frame claim.

outcome.error: Sampled current nonfinite or >=400pA software gate

limits: Current.Get and native samples are asynchronous. Counter brackets overlap for trigger, Stop and Withdraw, so no exact raw point is assigned to the TCP trigger.
The large positive Z transition and endpoint status occur under known commanded Withdraw. They do not establish a spontaneous crash or previous contact depth.
After Withdraw the near-zero current is an Off/Home observation, not recovered tunnelling.
The only recorded writers were Scan Start, Scan Stop and Withdraw. Proposed S01 setpoint, feedback and speed settings were not applied.
Stored0.5ms sample intervals are not calibrated analog bandwidth or a true-peak bound. Raster Z includes topography and controller response.
